aws-controllers-k8s/ack-chart.description: one chart to rule them all.
aws-controllers-k8s/ack-chart.readme_excerpt: The ACK Multi-Controller Helm chart, shortened to `ack-chart`, acts as a wrapper for all ACK controllers released under [General Availability (GA)][services]. `ack-chart` lists each ACK controller as a subchart dependency. `ack-chart` is currently in **developer preview** and is subject to breaking changes. Helm 3.8+ is required to install `ack-chart`, since it is hosted in an To install the latest version of `ack-chart`, use the following command: export LATEST_VERSION=`curl -sL https://api.github.com/repos/aws-controllers-k8s/ack-chart/releases/latest | grep '"tag_name":' | cut -d'"' -f4` helm install --create-namespace -n ack-system ack-chart \ oci://public.ecr.aws/aws-controllers-k8s/ack-chart --version=$LATEST_VERSION By default, when installing the `ack-chart`, **none of the subcharts are installed**. aws-controllers-k8s/ack-dev-skills.readme_excerpt: Development guidance for AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK), packaged as an Agent Skill for use with AI coding tools. aws-controllers-k8s/ackctl.name: ackctl
aws-controllers-k8s/ackctl.readme_excerpt: Command-line tools for [AWS Controllers for Kubernetes][ack] (ACK). Run `ackctl <command> --help` for flags and examples. Needs Go 1.24 or newer. go install github.com/aws-controllers-k8s/ackctl/cmd/ackctl@latest That installs the `ackctl` binary into `$(go env GOPATH)/bin`, which must be on your `PATH`. Pin a specific release instead of `@latest` with `...cmd/ackctl@v0.0.1`. Verify, and check what you installed: ackctl version From a clone: make build # -> bin/ackctl make install # -> $GOPATH/bin/ackctl Adopt every EKS Nodegroup tagged `Environment=prod`: ackctl adopt --service eks --kind Nodegroup --tag Environment=prod | kubectl create -f - Manifests go to stdout; nothing is applied to a cluster for you.

aws-controllers-k8s/acm-controller.name: acm-controller
aws-controllers-k8s/acm-controller.description: ACK Service controller for AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)
aws-controllers-k8s/acm-controller.readme_excerpt: This repository contains source code for the AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK) service controller for ACM. Please [log issues][ack-issues] and feedback on the main AWS Controllers for Kubernetes Github project. Learn more about installing ACK service controller for AWS Certificate Manager. The ACK service controller for AWS Certificate Manager is free of charge. If you issue an exportable public certificate with AWS Certificate Manager, there is a charge at certificate issuance and again when the certificate renews. Learn more about AWS Certificate Manager Pricing. The ACK service controller for AWS Certificate Manager uses Kubernetes TLS Secrets to store the certificate
readme_headings: ACK service controller for AWS Certificate Manager
Exporting an exportable ACM public certificate

aws-controllers-k8s/community.name: community
aws-controllers-k8s/community.description: AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK) is a project enabling you to manage AWS services from Kubernetes
aws-controllers-k8s/community.readme_excerpt: **AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK)** lets you define and use AWS service resources directly from Kubernetes. With ACK, you can take advantage of AWS managed services for your Kubernetes applications without needing to define resources outside of the cluster or run services that provide supporting capabilities like databases or message queues within the cluster. ACK is an open source project built with ❤️ by AWS. The project is composed of many source code repositories containing a [common runtime][runtime-repo], a Kubernetes custom controllers for individual AWS service APIs. * Overview * Getting Started * Help & Feedback * Contributing * License
